description_en: Removes multiple databases from an asset group at a time
description_zh: 从指定资产组中批量移除数据库
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost remove-databases-from-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1ghxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-id 1 --database-ids 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveDatabasesFromGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to manage.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
要移除数据库的资产组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to manage.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要移除数据库的资产组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group from which you want to remove databases.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html operation to query the asset group ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移除数据库的资产组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the databases that you want to remove
parameters.name: database_ids

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Code.description_en: The error code that is returned. If OK is returned, the operation was successful. If another error code is returned, the operation failed
Code.description_zh: 错误码，OK表示成功，其他表示错误

Message.description_en: The error message that is returned
